macros.name: actmark
macros.doc: When introducing, a new play, act or scene, respectively, commands \playmark{⟨label⟩}, \actmark{⟨label⟩} and \scenemark{⟨label⟩} are called, so that titles can be used in headers and footers.

macros.name: actname
macros.doc: Shortcut for \GetTranslation{Act}.

macros.name: cast
macros.doc: This command is the only one allowed inside a castgroup environment. It declares a new cast member (its only argument) for this group.

macros.name: characterspace
macros.doc: Command \characterspace put some vertical space into the dramatis personæ.

macros.name: curtain
macros.doc: At last, to mark the end of an act or of the play, you can use command \curtain, which prints the word \GetTranslation{Curtain} in the middle of its own line.

macros.name: curtainname
macros.doc: Shortcut for \GetTranslation{Curtain}.

macros.name: did
macros.doc: Display a stage direction inline.

macros.name: dramatiscast
macros.doc: Renders the cast name, inside a dramatischaractercastgroup.

macros.name: dramatischaracter
macros.doc: Renders the character name, description, and cast.

macros.name: dramatischaractercast
macros.doc: Renders the cast name.

macros.name: dramatischaracterdescription
macros.doc: Renders the character description.

macros.name: dramatischaractername
macros.doc: Renders the character name.

macros.name: interlude
macros.doc: Insert an interlude, which is an act or a scene which is not numbered, but which should appear in the table of content (unless the starred version is used).

macros.name: interludename

macros.name: pause
macros.doc: As we often need to mark pauses in theater, we created the command \pause, which is a shortcut for \did{\GetTranslation{Pause}}.

macros.name: pausename
macros.doc: Shortcut for \GetTranslation{Pause}.

macros.name: pauseverse
macros.doc: Used at the end of the verse to be continued.

macros.name: playname
macros.doc: Shortcut for \GetTranslation{Play}.

macros.name: resumeverse
macros.doc: Used at the beginning of the continuing verse.

macros.name: scenemark
macros.doc: When introducing, a new play, act or scene, respectively, commands \playmark{⟨label⟩}, \actmark{⟨label⟩} and \scenemark{⟨label⟩} are called, so that titles can be used in headers and footers.

macros.name: scenename
macros.doc: Shortcut for \GetTranslation{Scene}.

macros.name: setthalieoptions
macros.doc: Packages options can be reset in the document body using this command.

macros.name: speakswithoutdirection
macros.doc: Invoked to display a character’s name to introduce their line.
